contracts.name: R4.4 shows a form filled with the working example and its result when the link is missing a part, builds the 4.1 link on submit, and shows a refusal next to the form
R1.1 turns a local date, time and zone into the single UTC instant
R1.2 refuses a local time skipped by clocks jumping forward, naming the skipped range
R1.3 requires a choice when a local time happens twice, and returns the instant for the choice
R1.4 refuses an invalid date, time or zone with one plain sentence saying which one
R2.1 gives each guest the local date, local HH:MM and UTC offset at the start instant
R2.2 says whether a guest is on the day before or the day after the host
R2.3 orders guests by local time at the start instant, earliest first, ties by zone name
R3.1 marks a guest whose local start is from 00:00 up to but not including 06:00
R3.2 returns the on-the-hour start on the host date with the fewest dead-of-night guests, earliest on ties
R4.1 shows the party start for every guest in the link, using the same src/ functions as the tests
R4.2 shows a dead-of-night row with a ghost marker and the words "dead of night"
R4.3 uses a dark AA-contrast theme, no external assets, a phone-width layout and no animation under reduced motion
